content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overshoot true prices, especially in early periods.", "Sentiment peaks correlate with forecast peaks but rarely align with true price drops.", "Forecast bias is strongest when sentiment is neutral or negative.", "True prices exhibit mean-reversion after sharp forecast overestimates.", "Model accuracy declines when sentiment shifts rapidly or contradicts recent price trends.", "Forecast lags often occur when sentiment is bullish but prices fall due to external shocks.", "Sentiment-driven forecasts are more volatile than price-based models.", "True price movements often diverge from forecasts during periods of high sentiment volatility."]}
